# Dealer Vehicle Recon Command Pack

## Mission
Turn incoming inventory into a truthful, prioritized reconditioning queue and get vehicles lot-ready with fewer forgotten blockers.

## Daily sequence
1. Capture each incoming vehicle and source.
2. Record current iRecon stage and physical location.
3. Capture all recon needs and the next responsible department/vendor.
4. Escalate vehicles with aging, missing keys/docs, unresolved warning lights, unclear ownership or stalled approvals.
5. Run the Readiness Gate before calling a vehicle ready.
6. End the day with the five oldest unresolved vehicles and exact next actions.

## Truth rules
Do not infer that a vehicle is complete because it moved stages. Readiness requires the relevant checklist fields or evidence. Never invent iRecon status, repair approval, completion, key count or vehicle location.
